note: NECO Financial Accounting round 3 (Round 22 top-up): partnership current accounts, interest on drawings and capital, salaries in the appropriation account, ratio sharing (N120,000), goodwill payments to old partners, dissolution order of payment, club receipts and payments vs income and expenditure, accumulated fund, subscriptions prepaid and accrued, bar trading, entrance fees, single-entry weakness, statement of affairs, profit from capital movement (N180,000), mark-up vs margin (25% on cost = 20% margin), selling price N100,000, stock turnover 4x, return on capital 20%, high turnover and over-high current ratio signals, recurrent vs capital spending, votes, Accountant-General vs Auditor-General, stewardship and the Federation Account. Scanned against NECO rounds 1-2, WAEC Accounting (all rounds) and the JAMB pool.
